title: "Q14. Thoughts on the female ratio"

**What do you think about the percentage of female researchers in your
group (Q13)?**

Rated from *Very Poor* to *Very Good*, plus *No interest* and *Prefer not
to answer*.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent.parent))
from _helpers import bar, grouped_bar, load_bivariate, load_univariate, suppression_note  # noqa: E402

RATING_ORDER = [
    "Very Good",
    "Good",
    "Poor",
    "Very Poor",
    "No interest",
    "Prefer not to answer",
]
```

## Distribution

```{python}
# | echo: false
bar(load_univariate("q14"), "q14", title="Q14. Thoughts on the female ratio", sort=RATING_ORDER)
```

*Poor* is the most common answer, and *Poor* + *Very Poor* together
outnumber *Good* + *Very Good* — respondents are more dissatisfied than
satisfied with the gender ratio in their groups.
